claims.text: Suggestions are recalculated whenever Max Amount, Lynx Reference Amount or Crop Coefficient change.

evidence.ref: docs/claims/calculations.md §2.4 Recalculation after a settings change

claims.note: This happens when the values are changed and saved in Settings. The recalculation covers the selected course only (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:566; SpatialAdjustService.cs:1856-1859), and it matters only under Option 2: Option 1 uses none of the three.

claims.text: A station with no current scan and no model estimate shows a dash rather than a number.

evidence.ref: docs/claims/calculations.md §4 What the station table shows

claims.text: Lynx itself must be set up to match Spatial Adjust.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 p.1 lists the Lynx settings Spatial Adjust depends on: Site Adjust and Course Adjust, Pct. Adjust, and Next Amt.

claims.text: Find the two adjustment columns
Find [[Current]] and [[Suggested]] under the [[Adjustment]] heading of the table.
claims.note: Current and Suggested sit side by side under the Adjustment heading. Reworded from suggested-adjustments/1/5, suggested-adjustments/1/1.

claims.text: [[Current]] is the percent adjust Lynx holds now, and [[Suggested]] is what Spatial Adjust worked out from the latest scan.

evidence.ref: docs/claims/calculations.md §2.2 The chain, per station, per day

claims.note: Current is the percent adjust Lynx holds now; Suggested is the calculated percentage. Reworded from suggested-adjustments/1/2, suggested-adjustments/1/3.

claims.text: If the rows are areas or holes, they show averages only.
claims.note: Area and hole rows show only average measured, average target and the latest scan date; the Current, Suggested and % Adj. cells are drawn for station rows only (sa-table-card.component.html:29-39). Reworded from understanding-vwc/5/2, station-details/3/1.

claims.text: Select a row to open the next level, until you reach stations.
claims.note: The table drills from course to areas, then holes, then stations. Reworded from dashboard-overview/4/2, editing-station-targets/1/2.

claims.text: The gap between the two is the change you are being asked to make.
claims.note: The change is the difference between Suggested and Current. Reworded from suggested-adjustments/1/4.

claims.text: Current and Suggested sit side by side under the Adjustment heading.
claims.note: The station header shows "Adjustment" (en-us.json:607) above "Current" and "Suggested" (en-us.json:664, :1008).

claims.text: Read it against Avg. VWC and Target VWC
On the same row, compare [[Avg. VWC]] with [[Target VWC]].
claims.note: Avg. VWC and Target VWC are columns of the station table. Reworded from suggested-adjustments/2/1.

claims.text: A station well under its target asks for more water, and one over its target asks for less.
claims.note: Option 2 raises the amount for a station below its target and lowers it above. Reworded from suggested-adjustments/2/3.

claims.text: If [[Avg. VWC]] is grey and italic, the value is modelled from an older scan, so the suggestion rests on an estimate.

evidence.ref: docs/claims/calculations.md §4 What the station table shows

claims.note: A grey italic Avg. VWC is modelled (sa-table-card.component.html:29-31); a modelled station still gets a suggestion from the model value (sa-table-card.component.ts:417-435). Reworded from calculation-questions/4/2, station-details/4/2, suggested-adjustments/before/2.

claims.text: Station 3AP1 measured 27.6 percent against a 54 percent target — the largest deficit on the hole.
claims.note: Illustrative screenshot. A 54 percent target cannot be typed: the Target VWC box accepts 0 to 50 (sa-table-card.component.html:40-47), and bulk changes clamp to 0-50 (SpatialAdjustService.cs:2291-2292). It can still occur, because a station's first target is set automatically to its first measured VWC (:3128-3133). An example target of 50 or less would avoid the question.

evidence.ref: docs/claims/calculations.md §1.1 Daily Max Amount is a cap

claims.text: Look down the [[Suggested]] column for a run of the same value.

evidence.ref: docs/claims/calculations.md §1.1 Daily Max Amount is a cap

claims.note: Stations sharing a suggestion show it in the same column. Reworded from suggested-adjustments/3/2.

claims.text: Under [[Option 2]], every station that needs more than the daily cap shows the same, highest value.

evidence.ref: docs/claims/calculations.md §1.1 Daily Max Amount is a cap

claims.text: If most of the course shows that value, the cap is deciding, not the scan.

evidence.ref: docs/claims/calculations.md §1.1 Daily Max Amount is a cap

claims.note: A course that mostly reads the capped value is being decided by the cap. Reworded from suggested-adjustments/3/4, suggested-adjustments/3/5.

claims.text: Raise Daily Max Amount in [[Settings]] › [[Calculation]] if it is too low.
claims.note: Daily Max Amount is on the Calculation tab of Settings, opened from the toolbar. Reworded from suggested-adjustments/3/6.

claims.text: A run of identical suggestions is the signature of the Max Amount cap.

evidence.ref: docs/claims/calculations.md §1.1 Daily Max Amount is a cap

claims.text: Override where you disagree
Type your own value in the [[% Adj.]] box of a station you know behaves differently.
claims.note: The % Adj. box is the editable column. Reworded from suggested-adjustments/4/2, suggested-adjustments/4/3.

claims.text: Your value shows in [[% Adj.]], and [[Suggested]] keeps the calculated value.
claims.note: Typing in % Adj. leaves the Suggested value as calculated. Reworded from suggested-adjustments/4/3, suggested-adjustments/4/4.

claims.text: If a dash shows in place of the box, the station has no current scan and no modelled value, so there is nothing to adjust.

evidence.ref: docs/claims/calculations.md §4 What the station table shows

claims.note: Where a station has no current scan and no model estimate, the table draws a dash in place of the % Adj. box (sa-table-card.component.html:52). Reworded from suggested-adjustments/before/2.

claims.text: The push sends [[% Adj.]], so your value replaces the suggestion for that station.
claims.note: The push carries % Adj., not Suggested. Reworded from suggested-adjustments/4/5, suggested-adjustments/4/3.

claims.text: Editing % Adj. queues the station when the new value differs from what Lynx holds; a push icon appears beside the field only on a station that has been pushed before.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (suggested-adjustments/4/5); docs/text-corrections.md §17 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: Editing % Adj. queues the station; the icon beside the field marks it as pending.

claims.text: Set a soil factor for persistent offsets
In the Soil Factor Editor, type a value from 1 to 200 under [[Soil Factor (%)]] for the station.
claims.note: The editor takes 1 to 200 under the Soil Factor (%) column (sa-soil-factor-dlg.component.html:103-111); Soil Factor (%) is SOIL_FACTOR_PCT (en-us.json:473). Reworded from suggested-adjustments/5/3.

claims.text: The footer counts 1 pending change, and [[Save]] is no longer greyed out.
claims.note: Once a value differs, the footer counts the pending changes and Save is enabled (sa-soil-factor-dlg.component.html:113-118, :132-145; sa-soil-factor-dlg.component.ts:53-97).

claims.text: If the editor is not open, hold Shift + Alt and select the gear, [[Settings]].
claims.note: Shift + Alt on the toolbar gear opens the Soil Factor Editor. Reworded from suggested-adjustments/5/4, suggested-adjustments/5/5.

claims.text: To find the station, type its name under Filter station.
claims.note: The Soil Factor Editor has a Filter station box (sa-soil-factor-dlg.component.html:84-90). Reworded from suggested-adjustments/5/5.

claims.text: Under [[Option 2]], a soil factor scales the station’s calculated amount until someone changes it.
claims.note: The soil factor scales the calculated amount in the Option 2 calculation. Reworded from suggested-adjustments/5/3.

claims.text: Soil Factor Editor, opened with Shift + Alt on the toolbar gear.

claims.note: The footer of the Soil Factor Editor carries the Save button (sa-soil-factor-dlg.component.html:132-145).

claims.text: Soil Factor Editor, with Save and Cancel at the foot.
claims.note: The footer holds Save and Cancel (sa-soil-factor-dlg.component.html:132-145). Reworded from suggested-adjustments/5/5.
